name: The Last Egg
summary: Tibor the egg-hunter, camped at the Tsolenka landing, says the roc of Mount Ghakis lays once in eleven years, and this is the year. He has a buyer.

stages.journal: Tibor the egg-hunter, at the Tsolenka landing, has a buyer who'll pay four hundred gold for the roc's egg, and he'll split it with whoever carries the sack. The roc lays once in eleven years. This is the year.
objectives: Climb to the roc's nest on the shelf past the bridge
stages.hint: Cross the bridge on the Tsolenka Pass and climb to the roc's nest on the shelf beyond it. Watch Tibor while he talks about his buyer (Insight).

stages.journal: The egg was hatching, and the buyer was the count: his falconer and the stone birds off the tower came for the chick. We stood between them and the nest.
stages.hint: Go back to the roc's nest on the shelf past the bridge on the Tsolenka Pass.

stages.journal: The roc came back to her chick, and looked at us, and let us be. She won't trouble us on the bridge again.
We let the count's falconer take the roc's chick off the shelf, and Tibor paid us four hundred gold and said he was sorry.
